intro: Protect your skin every day with Kabira Skincare SPF 50 Sunscreen Cream, a lightweight, non-greasy formula that offers broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection.
Enriched with skin-loving ingredients, this sunscreen not only guards against sun damage but also hydrates and nourishes your skin, giving you a fresh, matte finish.

Its fast-absorbing formula ensures no white cast or sticky residue — making it perfect for daily use, even under makeup. Whether you’re heading outdoors or spending hours in front of screens, this SPF 50 sunscreen keeps your skin protected, moisturized, and radiant.
1. SPF 50 Broad Spectrum Protection – Shields skin from harmful UVA & UVB rays, preventing tanning, sunburn, and early signs of aging.
2. Non-Greasy & Lightweight Texture – Absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a sticky or white residue.
3. Hydrating & Nourishing Formula – Provides deep hydration to keep your skin soft, supple, and fresh all day long.
4. Perfect for All Skin Types – Gentle, dermatologically safe formula suitable for dry, oily, and combination skin.
5. Ideal for Daily Use – Protects skin during outdoor activities, office commutes, or extended
